file: 492 Zelda Ocarina of Time Is the Only 99 on Metacritic.mp4

lines.t: Ocarina of Time is the only video game ever to score a ninety nine on Metacritic.

full.credit: Clips: bradyONE; Smant; Austin John Plays (YouTube)

lines.t: It came out on the Nintendo 64 in November 1998.

full.credit: Clips: bradyONE; Smant; Austin John Plays (YouTube)

lines.t: It was the first three D Zelda, and it introduced Z targeting.

full.credit: Clips: bradyONE; Smant; Austin John Plays (YouTube)

lines.t: It sold more than seven million copies.

full.credit: Clips: bradyONE; Smant; Austin John Plays (YouTube)

lines.t: A remake launched on Switch 2 on November fifth, 2026, for fifty nine dollars and ninety nine cents.
